capabilities: Clip URLs into markdown notes with locally downloaded images and videos
Display clippings as a pannable, zoomable masonry wall of tiles
Organize clippings into grids, folders, and frontmatter-property filters
Auto-categorize and caption media using Claude via Claude Code, an API key, or a paid service
Revisit clips one by one to keep or forget them
extras: Freemium: the Power-Up subscription runs AI describing on the developer's server; Describe and Revisit are desktop-only; community resolvers send X/Instagram URLs to third-party mirrors (fxtwitter, kkinstagram).
motivation: The README frames the plugin as weaving scattered inspiration into a single wall, matching its namesake, a weaver who turns loose threads into one cloth.
problem: Web clippings lose their images and videos when source pages disappear, and a folder of clipped notes is hard to browse visually.

relations.evidence: Notes from the Obsidian Web Clipper | They appear on the wall
Describe calls Claude Haiku with a key from the Claude Console
yt-dlp fetches the full video of a clipped post

summary: Visual masonry wall for web clippings that lays notes out as pannable, zoomable tiles and downloads each clipping's media locally to survive link rot.
